title: 第17章 进城赚大钱第18章 狂赚一百三十两
slug: 打猎娶妻加点我无敌了
lines: 第二天，林夜一觉睡到了日上三竿。
他一边穿衣服一边出门，才发现自己是最晚醒来的。
林大河和徐虎正在院子里整理狼皮，徐林则是蹲在板车旁，将一张张皮子捆扎，码放得整整齐齐。
林小满正坐在劈柴的木墩上，撑着下巴好奇地盯着看，哪里还有昨晚惧怕的样子。
林夜拿了根柳树枝，蹲在一旁洗漱。
随后来到板车旁，只是轻轻一抬，成摞的狼肉就被他放在板车上。
他又往肉上铺了一层油布，将扎好的狼皮一股脑放了上去。
板车再次被堆得满满当当，所有人看着它的目光像是看着一座铜钱山。
常氏从灶房端出饼子和热水，招呼几人先垫垫肚子。
林夜洗了把手，抓起一张饼卷上咸菜，边吃边往板车上瞅。
那张狼王皮和其他狼皮放在一起十分醒目，灰白色的毛在阳光下透着荧光，好像绸缎一般。
林大河盯着看了会，摇摇头：
“太扎眼，一会把它往里放，再盖上布，防着点泼皮。”
徐林咬了一大口饼，含糊不清地问道：
“那狼王的肉咋办？”
徐虎瞥了他一眼：
“成了精的东西邪得很，吃了指不定出啥事呢，更不能卖。”
林夜道：“进了城我去打听一下，不行就直接烧了。”
一顿早食，几人吃得心不在焉，刚吃完一个个迫不及待地推着板车要出门
小满噔噔噔跑出来，抓住林大河的裤腿。
“爹，我也想去县城！”
常氏从灶房追了出来，一把将小丫头抱起。
“你去干啥，一帮大老爷们绑起来哪里顾得上你。”
小丫头憋着嘴，委屈巴巴：
“小满会很乖的……”
“外面有拍花子，一不留神就给你拍走了，下次娘专门带你去。”
常氏小声哄着，林夜也蹲下身摸了摸她的头。
“小满乖，哥哥给你带糖葫芦。”
小丫头这才吸了吸鼻子，点着小脑袋。
林夜站起身，重新拉起板车，林大河在旁扶着，徐家叔侄在后面推。
四个人出了村，上了官道，往曲县的方向走。

The next day, Lin Ye slept until three o'clock in the morning.
As he was getting dressed and going out, he realized that he was the last to wake up.
Lin Dahe and Xu Hu were sorting the wolf skins in the yard, while Xu Lin was squatting beside the cart, bundling the skins one by one and stacking them neatly.
Lin Xiaoman was sitting on the wooden pier where he was chopping firewood, holding his chin and staring curiously. There was no trace of fear from last night.
Lin Ye took a willow branch and squatted aside to wash.
Then he came to the cart and with just a slight lift, he placed piles of wolf meat on the cart.
He spread another layer of oilcloth on the meat and put all the tied wolf skins on top.
The cart was piled full again, and everyone looked at it as if they were looking at a mountain of coins.
Mrs. Chang brought out pancakes and hot water from the kitchen and asked a few people to fill their bellies first.
Lin Ye washed his hands, grabbed a piece of pancake and rolled it with pickles, and looked at the trolley while eating.
The wolf king's skin is very eye-catching when placed next to other wolf skins. The gray-white fur fluoresces in the sun, like silk.
Lin Dahe stared for a while and shook his head:
"It's too eye-catching. I'll put it inside and cover it with a cloth to prevent it from splattering."
Xu Lin took a big bite of the cake and asked vaguely:
"What to do with the Wolf King's meat?"
Xu Hu glanced at him:
"The semen is very evil. If you eat it, something might happen, and you can't sell it."
Lin Ye said: "I'll go find out when we get into the city. If it doesn't work, I'll just burn it."
A few people were eating breakfast absentmindedly. They had just finished eating and they were all eager to push their carts to go out.
Xiaoman ran out and grabbed Lin Dahe's trouser leg.
"Dad, I also want to go to the county seat!"
Mrs. Chang chased her out of the kitchen and picked up the little girl.
"What are you going to do? How can a bunch of big men tie you up and care about you?"
The little girl held her mouth and said aggrievedly:
"Xiaoman will be very good..."
"There were flowers being photographed outside, and they were taken away by you without me noticing. Mom will take you there specially next time."
Chang coaxed in a low voice, and Lin Ye also knelt down and touched her head.
"Xiaoman, be good, brother will bring you candied haws."
The little girl sniffed and nodded her head.
Lin Ye stood up and pulled up the cart again. Lin Dahe was supporting him and his uncles and nephews from the Xu family were pushing behind.
The four people left the village, took the official road, and headed towards Qu County.
title_en: Chapter 17: Go to the city to make big money Chapter 18: Make a huge profit of one hundred and thirty taels
